root_cause: /var/validation ran out of space (20.0G/20.0G) while data-ingest was exporting test 1847's measurements, so the export stopped after 1180 of 1500 rows but was still marked READY, and the estimator read the partial last row as NaN.

evidence.note: volume already at 95% (19.0G/20.0G) when the batch started
98% at 02:14:00, one minute before the failure
export of batch_1847_vectors.csv fails with [Errno 28] No space left on device at offset 37104
the failed export is still published: 1180 rows, 36.2 KB, status=READY (every other export is 1500 rows, ~46 KB)
estimator-01 reads 1181 rows: 1180 complete plus the partial row cut off by the failed write
partial row 1181 has an empty second field, parsed as NaN
covariance non-finite, worker aborts with 0 states
runner records FAIL: worker error 'non-finite result', states=0 expected=1500
retention hook frees 6.1G at 02:15:18, so the disk looked healthy afterwards

ruled_out.reason: other worker (1847 ran on estimator-01); license reacquired 1.2 s later with no task interrupted (line 168)
different test, 7 minutes earlier, passed on retry with normal error (line 51)

ruled_out.item: estimator-02 slow to ack / RT throttling
